text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc and Patriot American Hospitality Operating Co said on Monday they have completed the acquisition of Grand Heritage Hotels for $22 million in preferred shares of Patriot American Hospitality Operating Partnership LP.
Patriot American Hospitality Inc already completed the acquisition of real estate included in the original deal.

With the completed acquisition, Patriot American Hospitality Operating Co adds Grand Heritage's 80 hotel management and marketing contracts in the U.S., Europe, the United Kingdom and the Caribbean, representing 5,928 rooms, to the company's portfolio.
In addition to being immediately accretive for Patriot American, the company expects the acquisition of Grand Heritage Hotels positions Patriot to accelerate its expansion plans.
Patriot American Hospitality Inc, a real estate investment trust, and Patriot American Hospitality Operating Co, a hotel management firm, are two companies that trade under a single stock.
